messages.subject: Re: axes location
parts:
Sorry I guess my question is about the axis line placement. I have a hard time with single vowel discrimination.

On Tuesday, April 2, 2013 5:50:17 PM UTC-4, Matthew Perkins wrote:

is it possible to position the x and y axis over the coordinate plane, like grade school? I have some matplotlib/python stuff I would rather do here. Example is below

messages.author: 373beb702917b8b5
messages.subject: Re: axes location
parts:
I could be wrong, but I think you have to do it manually. Here is an example:

tmp <- data.frame(x=0:20, y=-10:10)

ggplot(tmp, aes(x=x, y=y)) +
geom_point() +
scale_x_continuous(expand=c(0,0)) +
## make our own x axis at y=0
annotate(geom="line", x=c(-1, 21), y=0) +
annotate(geom="linerange", x=seq(0, 20, 2), ymin=0, ymax=.25) +
annotate(geom="text", x=seq(0, 20, 2), y=-.5, label=seq(0, 20, 2), size=4) +
## turn off the default x axis
theme(axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
axis.text.x = element_blank())

HTH,
Ista
